style.name: Neumorphism
style.description: Neumorphism uses paired light and dark shadows to make controls appear pressed into or raised from a shared surface. Its quiet, low-contrast material effect works best when explicit labels and visible boundaries support the interaction.

fonts.heading: Nunito
fonts.rationale: Rounded headings suit soft relief while an efficient body face makes labels and state changes clearer.

tips: Add visible focus and selected states.
Use stronger text contrast than the surface effects.
Keep the relief effect for a few key controls.
avoid: Using shadows as the only state indicator.
Applying soft relief to every data-heavy component.

recipe.composition: Use a narrow range of surfaces; distinguish controls with paired shadows and a visible focus boundary.
recipe.motion: Pressed controls move to an inset surface; preserve an explicit selected label.
recipe.signature: Soft extruded controls that share their background while retaining recognizable affordances.
